meta.source: IPEDS completions by 6-digit CIP, via the Urban Institute Education Data API (educationdata.urban.org)
meta.row: one (year, institution, CIP-6, award level) count of completions, race=99 sex=99 totals
meta.counting_rule: IPEDS counts COMPLETIONS, not programs and not enrolment. A program with no completions in a year may be absent from that year. Enumerate programs from the UNION of years, never one year.
meta.majornum: filter applied from 2000 only; the field does not exist earlier
meta.no_rubber_cip: There is no rubber-specific CIP code. Rubber is taught inside 14.3201 and 15.0607 and cannot be separated in this source.
